title: Algorithmic Approaches to Opinion Selection for Online Deliberation: A Comparative Study

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the median percentage of unrepresented users and calculating maximin cross-group agreement (consensus) across distinct political affiliation groups (e.g., Very conservative, Slightly liberal, Moderate) to evaluate if algorithmic selection disproportionately ignores certain ideological factions.

Evaluating the coverage gap, opinion redundancy, and individual-level representation to ensure that highly approved (popular) opinions do not systematically crowd out niche or minority viewpoints during algorithmic opinion selection.
